title: O/P/U probabilities asserted in the 10:05Z-turn report that no replay ever produced
what_happened: The assistant's chat report after commit bb97de7 displayed a four-row table of totals probabilities (TOR@TB 7.5 .674/.090/.236; DET@PIT 7.5 .646/.093/.261 and 8.0 .553/.096/.351; MIA@PHI 8.5 .615/.088/.297; LAD@COL 11.5 .580/.073/.347) attributed to the verified replay. Those numbers were never computed by any tool call — the report was written without reading the replay artifact back.
how_it_was_caught: Owner cross-checked the next card display against the earlier report and found the two surfaces inconsistent. The decisive tell, per owner: push probability on HALF-POINT lines. Simulated run totals are integers, so P(total == x.5) is structurally zero; any triple with push mass at 7.5/8.5/11.5 cannot have come from the arrays.
which_surface_was_wrong: THE CHAT REPORT ONLY. The committed artifacts (unified-card price_evaluation lines, replay artifact) are mutually identical, obey half-line-push-zero, and reproduce under a fresh certification replay.
root_cause: R1-class reporting failure by the assistant: values asserted in the user-facing summary without sourcing them from the artifact. Same failure family as invented data — the artifact chain was clean, the narration was not.

quarantine_and_resolution.imposed: TOTAL_PROBABILITY_REPLAY_CONFLICT on all MLB total probabilities (owner instruction); O/P/U suppressed from display while in force
resolution_evidence: unified_card.totals_gate() implemented with owner's rules: half-line n_push==0; counts partition the array exactly (p_over+p_push+p_under==1; half-line p_over+p_under==1); every distinct captured total quote carries its own quote_id; no collapsing split lines into one probability pair; every quote binds the exact line value and the sim-array sha256
selftest fixtures added, including the incident case (push mass on a half line MUST fail) — unified_card selftest PASS
fresh certification replay: 6-field verification PASS 15/15 games; totals_gate PASS on all 30 quotes; certified probabilities IDENTICAL to the committed unified card
quarantine_and_resolution.status: RESOLVED 2026-08-19T10:39:42Z — quarantine lifted; O/P/U may be displayed ONLY from gate-certified values with quote_ids

standing_rule: Report-layer numbers are subject to R1 exactly like artifact numbers: any probability shown to the owner must be read from a tool-produced artifact in the same turn, never reconstructed. The totals_gate makes the half-line invariant mechanical so this class of fabrication is detectable on sight.

wnba_display_convention_correction.issue: the same report rendered TOR@WAS as 'Proj margin (home): WAS −3.9… i.e. +3.87 WAS' — mixing margin and fair spread
wnba_display_convention_correction.note: stored artifacts were already correct (margin_home=+3.87, delta=−5.63, selection TOR +9.5); display convention now fixed: margin and fair spread are stated as separate labeled quantities, never blended. MIN@GSV was already coherent (GSV home margin −1.53, line +2.5, delta +0.97, ATS GSV +2.5).
